info.name: Self-Service Employee Module
info.description: Complete Postman collection for self-service employee endpoints organized folder-wise

item.name: GET My Unique Class Section Subjects

request.description: Returns course sessions when the course is mapped to the logged-in teacher via subject mapping or timetable.

item.name: GET My Exam Schedule by ID

request.description: Returns exam schedule details when assigned to the logged-in teacher via teacherExamAssignment.
POST /attendance/my/import — teacher self-service attendance import (file field: attendance).
POST /attendance/my/excelImport — teacher self-service bulk excel attendance import (file field: attendance).

item.name: GET My Employee Subject And Lesson

request.description: Returns { label, value } course options for the logged-in teacher. Returns [] when not mapped.
GET /options/my/lessons?lectureWindowId=10 — lesson options for a lecture window owned by the logged-in teacher.
GET /options/my/topics?lessonId=19 — topic options for a lesson owned by the logged-in teacher.
Returns active leave policies for the logged-in user (no LEAVE_POLICY admin permission required). Use for apply-leave policy dropdown.
Returns [] when user has no employee record (not 404).

item.name: Evaluation
item.description: Teacher self-service answer-sheet evaluation APIs from answerSheetQrRoute (/my).

request.description:
GET /answerSheetQr/my — scripts assigned to the logged-in teacher.

Response data:
- filteredrows[]
- teacher { userId, userName, email }

Returns empty filteredrows when user has no employee record (not 404).

GET /answerSheetQr/my/summary — evaluation counts for the logged-in teacher.

Response:
- totalAssigned
- evaluated
- pending

Returns zero counts when user has no employee record (not 404).
Returns [] when user has no employee record (not 404).
